presets.label: Clean portrait
presets.description: Simple portrait with a neutral background and no face refinement.
presets.prompt_example: adult woman, looking at the camera, neutral expression, wearing a white shirt, soft natural window light
presets.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted face, deformed eyes, extra fingers, text, watermark

presets.label: White background
presets.description: Studio-style portrait with a clean white background.
presets.prompt_prefix: realistic portrait photo, pure white seamless background, soft even studio lighting
presets.prompt_example: adult woman in her late thirties, looking at the camera, neutral gentle expression, natural skin texture
presets.negative_prompt: busy background, room, window, trees, car, objects, blurry, low quality, distorted face, deformed eyes, text, watermark

presets.label: White background + eyes
presets.description: White-background portrait with optional Eyeful eye refinement.
presets.prompt_prefix: realistic portrait photo, pure white seamless background, soft even studio lighting
presets.prompt_example: adult woman in her late thirties, brown eyes, three-quarter portrait, calm expression, natural skin texture
presets.negative_prompt: busy background, room, window, trees, car, objects, blurry, low quality, distorted face, deformed eyes, asymmetrical eyes, text, watermark

presets.label: CyberRealistic portrait
presets.description: Experimental portrait preset using the installed CyberRealisticXL model.
presets.prompt_example: adult woman, outdoor portrait, wearing a dark jacket, trees in the background, natural daylight
presets.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted face, deformed eyes, extra fingers, text, watermark

presets.label: Portrait + brown eyes
presets.description: Identity portrait with an explicit natural brown eye color.
presets.prompt_prefix: realistic portrait photo, natural facial features
presets.prompt_example: adult woman in her late thirties, brown eyes, looking at the camera, calm expression, soft natural light
presets.negative_prompt: blue eyes, green eyes, gray eyes, blurry, low quality, distorted face, deformed eyes, text, watermark
